summary: After and later; also those who come after us, descendants. 後生, the young, may surpass us.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Lorenz-84 trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 望 takes the highest point, gazing up; 劫 the point farthest from the rest, at the edge of the eon. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Will He Have No Descendants?
satellites.evidence: Mencius 1A4 quotes Confucius on the first maker of tomb figurines: 始作俑者，其無後乎 — “whoever first made figures to bury with the dead, surely he will have no posterity!”, because they were made in human likeness. Mencius turns it on a king whose stables are fat while 野有餓莩, the starved lie in the fields. 後 is the future as descendants.
